messages:
deploy-bot: predeploy-eval for release v2.13.1: ALERT — regression detected on prompt set 'email-summarizer' (mean ROUGE-L -4.2%). Blocking promotion to global. CI: https://ci.internal/redwood/rs-2131
Sophie: seeing the alert, thanks. is the regression tied to quant changes or attention kernel swap?
Mike: initial look — correlates with the new attention kernel + int8 quant path. small but consistent on long emails (>1024 tokens).
Lina: QA manual pass: headers and line-break formatting corrupted in ~8% of samples. attaching a couple of short examples:
```
INPUT: Subject: Team sync
OUTPUT (v2.13.1): team sync: tomorrow we...
OUTPUT (v2.12.7): Subject: Team sync
Dear team, here's the agenda...
```
Raj: FYI we have a change window at 22:00 UTC tonight. If we can’t get a patch in, we should consider pinning the summarizer route to v2.12.7 to avoid user impact.
Mike: proposal: pin the summarizer route to v2.12.7 immediately, then promote v2.13.1 to a 5% internal canary excluding that route. I’ll run a quick bisect to isolate the commit.
Sophie: that sounds reasonable — pin + canary. Product prefers minimal visible impact. @Lina can QA sign off on that flow?
qa-bot: QA Approval required: explicit +1 from QA lead (@Lina) and ML lead (@Mike) for canary to proceed.
Lina: :thumbsup: I will +1 if we pin the route and add a regression alert (ROUGE-L drift >2% on the summarizer prompt set -> rollback).
Mike: +1 from ML side. I’ll add the alert and start bisecting; target fix in next patch.
deploy-bot: Action plan (agreed):
1) pin route 'summarizer' -> model:v2.12.7
2) promote v2.13.1 to 5% internal canary, exclude 'summarizer' route
3) monitor "RW/rouge/rolling" dashboard; regression alert rollback threshold ROUGE-L delta <= -2%
4) if alert fires, auto-rollback summarizer to v2.12.7
Commands to run now:
```bash
rdeploy pin-route summarizer model:v2.12.7
rdeploy promote --release v2.13.1 --percent 5 --exclude-route summarizer --note "internal canary"
```
Raj: executing pin now.
deploy-bot: pin complete. canary promotion queued — will start at 21:30 UTC. links: https://dash.internal/redwood/rouge, runbook: https://wiki.internal/runbooks/eval-gate
Sophie: thanks — I’ll update the release notes: "email summarizer pinned to v2.12.7 due to predeploy quality gate; v2.13.1 promoted to 5% internal canary (excludes summarizer)."
Mike: opened bisect PR: https://git.internal/redwood/pulls/456 — assigned to @Mike, will report findings in this thread.
